_help: This file lists YOUR providers and models. API keys are never written here:
the installer asks for each provider's key and stores it encrypted for your Windows account.
providers : one entry per provider. The id is a short lower-case name you choose.
endpoint must be the provider's OpenAI *Responses* API URL (https://.../responses).
The ids minimax, mimo and alibaba get provider-specific tuning; any other id is treated generically.
models    : one entry per model you want in the Codex model picker.
provider        id from the providers section
model           exact model id the provider expects
context_window  the model's context size in tokens (check your provider's documentation)
image_input     true if the model accepts images (optional, default false)
auto_fallback   true on the ONE model Codex should switch to automatically when your
ChatGPT allowance runs out (optional, default: the first model)
protocol        leave out unless your provider implements Codex's 'responses-lite' format
Replace everything below with your own values. Entries under _examples are ignored; copy from them if useful.
